text:
alex: Heads up — this morning ~08:10 UTC a subset of ded-ml pods failed during startup in eu-west. Error was KMS UnwrapFailure when fetching envelope key for model weights. Also noticed GPU pool attach failing for the same jobs.
riley: any deploys/rollouts around that time?
alex: small config rollout from ci:deploy at 08:02. deploy-bot shows serviceAccount=deployer-main used.
sam: logs show the deployer-main SA lost iam:decrypt to the KMS key after the rolebinding cleanup PR (PR #2419). suspect the RBAC/name-mapping change removed impersonation privileges for the kms-unwrapper role.
kyle: confirmed — rolebinding gpu-scheduler-binding still allows deployer-main to bind to clusterrole kube-scheduler-proxy (list nodes) but we revoked iam:Decrypt in the cloud KMS IAM. Two separate faults.
audIT-bot: Alert: KMS unwrap failures spike 08:10-08:24 UTC, 124 events. Affected pods: ded-ml-{pod ids}.
alex: we need a quick mitigation: re-grant decrypt to the dedicated KMS service account used by runtime-kms-proxy, or short-lived manually rebind the deployer-main to kms-unwrapper role for 2 hours.
riley: prefer least-privilege fix: create kms-proxy-sa and give it only kms:decrypt for the key, update runtime to use that SA for unwrap. roll this fast with canary.
sam: I can open a hotfix PR to create kms-proxy-sa + RoleBinding -> kube-system:deployments. Also add an audit condition so any future removal triggers pager.
kyle: for GPU attach, add a separate Role with verbs: [get,list,watch] on nodes and allow only gpu-scheduler-sa. detach deploy privileges from deployer-main for node listing.
alex: agreed. also add an eval in CI that runs a quick KMS unwrap with the SA after RBAC changes (tests/integration/kms_rbac_check.sh)
alex: minimal remediation plan:
- revert PR #2419 to restore KMS IAM bindings (rollback window 30m)
- deploy kms-proxy-sa hotfix (sam)
- tighten node-list role and bind to gpu-scheduler-sa (kyle)
- add pager rule on audit logs for KMS unwrap errors (riley)
- postmortem and policy doc about separating cloud KMS IAM vs k8s RBAC (owner: alex)

sam: i'll post PR links in thread and start the hotfix now. tagging @kyle for node role change.
kyle: on it, will open PR and coordinate with infra to schedule redeploy to gpu-pool.
riley: thanks. once stable let's add a CI gate and a short runbook for oncall.
deploy-bot: Deploy rollback triggered for PR#2419 by alex at 08:34 UTC :information_source:
alex: updating the incident doc + will create a short RFC to capture least-privilege service account split.
